definitions.explanation: The period of dim light between day and night, particularly the time just after sunset when the sky still holds some light. A literary and formal term.

examples.japanese: {薄暮|はくぼ}の{中|なか}を{歩|ある}く。
{薄暮|はくぼ}{時|じ}は{事故|じこ}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Accidents are common during twilight hours.

examples.japanese: {薄暮|はくぼ}の{空|そら}に{一番星|いちばんぼし}が{輝|かがや}いていた。
examples.english: The first star was shining in the twilight sky.

notes:
FORMS:
{薄|はく} (thin, faint) + {暮|ぼ} (dusk, evening)

REGISTER:
{薄暮|はくぼ} is a literary/formal term. In everyday conversation, {夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ or {日暮|ひぐ}れ are more common.

TRAFFIC SAFETY:
{薄暮|はくぼ}{時|じ} (twilight hours) is particularly dangerous for driving because visibility decreases but headlights are not yet fully effective.

RELATED WORDS:
- {夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ: evening, dusk (common)
- {黄昏|たそがれ}: twilight (literary)
- {日暮|ひぐ}れ: dusk, sunset
- {黎明|れいめい}: dawn (opposite time)
